top_concerns: Probabilities for several high‑likelihood diagnoses were underestimated (diabetic nephropathy, CKD‑MBD, CKD anemia).
Infection susceptibility and psychosocial stressors were omitted from the differential.
Lack of recent imaging and labs (BP, calcium‑phosphate‑PTH, iron studies, glucose logs) limits certainty for several items.
Hypertensive nephrosclerosis cannot be confirmed without blood‑pressure data.
review_summary: The junior differential captured the major organ‑system problems but under‑weighted the dominant diagnosis and missed key clinical concerns (infection risk, psychosocial factors, transplant eligibility). Adjusted probabilities reflect the true pre‑test likelihoods, and additional work‑up items are highlighted to move several plausible items into the supported category.
